tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// snyan brgyud mgon po'i sgrub thabs 'phrin las kun 'grub bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// rgyal ba kun gyi snying rje'i thugs// nag po'i bdud las khros nas su// drag po'i 'phrin las kun mdzad par// btud de de bsnyen byed thabs bri// dpal bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi bka' bsrungs mgon po bsgrub par 'dod pas/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum mam/ cig car du 'dod na/ phyi pho nya ltar bsnyen pa/ nang sras ltar bsnyen pa/ gsang ba rang dang gnyis med du bsnyen pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang nyid dpa' 'khor lo sdom pa'am lhan cig skyes ma'i bdag bskyed bsgoms nas/ rten rdzas rnams swa bhā was sbyangs nas/ mdun du pad+ma dang nyi ma bam gyi khar/ hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros gdug pa can thams cad btul/ dregs pa thams cad kyi srog bsdus te de la thim pa las hūṃ mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa srin po'i gzugs can rang gi sha la za ba tsam du gtum pa/ gad rgyangs dang bcas ba'i so dang mchu las khrag 'dzag cing spyan gsum dmar po dbu skra ser po thod 'phreng gis bcings shing phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar bzung ba dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan te/ g.yon brkyang gis ro rlon pa dang keng rus kyi khar bzhugs pa ye shes kyi me'i phung po mi zad par 'phro ba/ zhing skyong ba'i ma mo'i tshogs 'bum phrag mang pos bskor ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥsnying gar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ u rgyan sprul pa'i zhing la sogs pa nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po za byed mkha' 'gro'i chogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥhūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs nag po chen po'i tshogs// dpal ldan mgon po 'dir gshegs shig /lha chen dpal 'bar 'dir gshegs shig /rnam 'byor dgra lha= rig 'dzin bsrungs ma= bdud 'dul dpa' bo= lha min g.yul bzlog=

lha dmag dbyugs 'byin= sde dpon chen po= nag po mi gzan= khyod ni chos nyid rang bzhin te// dbyings las bzhengs pa mi mnga' yang*// rab 'bar 'jigs pa'i skur bstan nas// bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol// e h+ye hi ma mahā kā la hūṃ ni hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥ byon nas/ sngar bskyed pa dang dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pas dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las badz+ra he ru ka khros pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa ni bdud rtsi yaṃ raṃ kaṃ las rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor la thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la a las pad+ma'i snod/ de'i steng du bi mu ma ra shu/ go ku na da ha la bdud rtsi lnga sha lnga/ oṃ sbyangs/ āḥspel/ hūṃ sbar te bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam la/ hūṃ/ nag po chen po drag shul can// 'jig rten pa dang mthun pa'i phyir// phyag dang zhabs gnyis bsil mdzod la// dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas 'di bzhes shig /dmar chen khrag sna'i ar+ghaṃ sbreng*// dbang po rnams kyi me tog bstar// gsur chen spos kyi dud sprin 'thul// zhun chen mar me'i 'phreng ba bsgrigs// khrag zhag thal ba'i byug pa bshams// bdud rtsi lngar bcas dza gad phud// sgron ma lnga sogs bza' bca'i rigs// rnga sil dung gling rol mo'i tshogs// nag po chen po khyod pa 'bul// dpa' chen thugs dam gnyan po skong*// rnal 'byor bar chad zhi gyur cig /oṃ mahā kā la yak+ṣa sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha khā ti/ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa 'dul// tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste// grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig byed pa/ gtum po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ/ mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che// gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas// g.yon pa thod pa khrag bkang snod// thod 'phreng can la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ/

khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo// 'jig pa'i gad mos ri rabs bsgyel// dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa// dam tshig can la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūṃ/ dur khrod chen po'i klong dkyil du// 'jigs byed ma mo'i tshogs la rol// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i// rig 'dzin dgra lha chen por bstod// hūṃ/ 'jig rten 'dir ni gang zhig gis// mtshan nas brjod te bsgrubs pa la// myur du dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i// nam mkha'i mdzod pa khyod la 'dud// de nas thugs khar gri gug gi lte bar sngags kyis bskor ba de las 'od zer 'phros pas gdug pa can bstan pa la gnod par byed pa rnams tshar bcad dregs pa thams cad kyi nus mthu bsdus te snying po'i sngags sa bon dang bcas pa la thim/ yang sangs rgyas chos de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs bsdus te de'i sku gsung thugs la thim pas mgon po de dpa' ba rngam pa/ gzi brjid che ba/ ci bsgo ba'i las la thogs pa med par 'jug pa sus kyang mi thub pa/ cis kyang mi shigs pa/ khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa/ srid pa gsum dbang du sdud pa zhig tu bsams te/ gzhan las mthun gyi dmigs pa bya/ oṃ mahā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da hūṃ zhes bzla'o// de nas sha khrag bza' btung dang bcas pa'i snod/ e las gnam lcags kyi rang bzhin/ las kyi gshin rje'i khang sgrom zur gsum gting ring la kha rub pa/ mun pa mun nag tu 'thibs pa'i nang du/ gtor rdzas rnams gnod par byed pa'i dgra bo dang bgegs lus rid pa yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa/ bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag pa/ mig shi mig tu lta ba zhig tu gyur/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ snying po sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ rnal 'byor pa bdag la 'tshe/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod/ sems can thams cad la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad dmigs pa'i nya'u 'di rnams la khug cig ces bden pa bdar/ oṃ ma hā kā la gling byin ni tsit+ta rbad/ ma hā kā la tsit+ta kha rag dza/ zhes rbad pas/ dmigs bya mgon po nag po 'khor bcas kyis lcags kyus snying la btab/ zhags pas mgrin pa bcings/ lcags sgrog gis yan lag bsdams te dril bus mnyed cing 'brub khung du bcug /rdo rje slob dpon la sdang zhing*// rdo rje spun la 'khu ba dang*// rnal 'byor bdag cag la gnod byed// de dag mgon po nag pos sgrol// zhes bsgo zhing*/ oṃ mahā kā la rni thuṃ laṃ thuṃ ril rbad su rni dza dgra bo che ge mo'i snying la trag rak+ṣa thum ril rbad/ snying kha rag dza zhes brjod/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis de'i bsrung ba byin rlabs ye shes kyi lha'i skyabs las kyi tshe bsring ba'i nus mthu thams cad bdag la bsdus/ 'jig rten pa'i lha bros pas de lha yi mgon skyabs dang bral nas nag hrul song ba la 'khor rnams kyis mtshon chas bsgral bsad gtubs byed par bsam/ de nas/ yan lag rnams kyi sha chod la// nag po chen po'i zhal du gsol// khrag gi rgyun yang btung bar mdzod// de yi tshe srog dbang du bsdus// snying khrag dron mo zhal du gsol// de yi 'khor du gnas pa rnams// til tsam du ni mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod pas dam can rnams zhal gnam sa tsam du gdangs/ mche ba gangs ri tsam gnyer/ mid pa stong gsung tsam brgyangs te/ rngam rngam hab hab/ cham cham chem chem/ lhag ma med par gsol bas tshim par bsam la/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā kā la i daṃ bha ling+ta khā hi/ ho: dgongs su gsol/ dpal ldan nag po chen po rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ dam nyams kyi srog gcod/ rig 'dzin gyi srung ma/ dkar po'i chos skyong*/ nag po'i dgra 'dul/ lha'i dmag dpon/ lha min gyi gshed ma/

bdun 'dul gyi dbang phyug /khro bo chen po las su khyod bsgrubs don du khyod gnyer ba yin pas/ ma rungs pa'i dgra bgegs 'di tshar chod cig ces brjod/ bzlog na phas kyi mthu/ bgegs kyis sbyar ba'i ltas ngan pa/ sngon gyi las ngan/ 'phral gyi rkyen/ mis gzo ba las byung ba'i gnod pa thams can zlog par gyur cig yang zhi bar 'dod na/ gtod rdzas bdud rtsi bzhin/ rgyas pa 'dod na/ gtor rdzas shing thog sman lha'i bza' bca' btung bar dmigs nas phul/ 'dod gsol gyi gsham bu/ nad dang gnod pa dang sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba dang*/ lus dang tshe dang dpa' dang longs spyod dang stobs mnga' thang thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ dbang la skyes pa'am bud med nor gang 'dod pa de bdag gi mdun du dgug pa dang bdag ci 'dod pa byed pa'i dbang du 'gyur bar sogs/ drag po bskrad dam nang dbye'am rmongs lkug gam rims kyis gdungs pa sogs kyang 'dod gsol gyis bsgyur ro// de nas thun mthar mgon po 'khor bcas rten la bstim pa'am rang nyid 'dug gi ring la bar chad bsrung phyir bzhugs par gsol te dge ba bsngo shis pa brjod par bya'o gnyis pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas hūṃ 'phros pa de las lhar slong*/ gsum pa ni/ rang nyid kyi sems hūṃ du/ gtor ma'i dus thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor bcas spyan drangs par bsam/ gzhan 'dra/ dbang po rtul na bsnyen dus su gtor ma chang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs la phul/ 'dod gsol gyi sham bur bdag la zhal myur du bstan nas 'phrin las thams cad thogs pa med par mdzad du gsol/ de ltar ma mdzad na rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan sngar zhal bzhes pa'i dam tshig gnyen po bral ba yin pas nag po chen po khyod 'khor dang bcas pa dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ro zhes bsgrag go /de ltar bsnyen nas sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i tshe/ drag po'i gnas su maṇ+ḍal khru gang gru bzhi/

de'i steng du gru gsum brtsegs khrag dang dug ro sol gyis nag por byug /mtha' zlum por btang*/ de'i phyi rtsibs drug me ri rtsang dmar srin mo 'gros su gzug /dbus gru gsum gyi nang du 'khor lo rtsibs drug rtsibs re'i nang du lid+ga re/ dbus su yang gling bzhi dbus kyi phyir zur drug gi 'brub khung la phur pas bsdams/ lid+ga'i mtha' ma bsad sngags kyis bskor ba'o// mchod gtor gyi mtha' skor/ dang por 'bod pa/ thun la pho nya bskyed bstim/ de nas rbad pa/ de nas bsad pa rnams rtags thon par bya ste/ dmigs pa dang 'don bya ni sngar bshad pa de kha'o// mthar gtor rdzas dgra la 'phang*/ 'phang dus/ rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs shing*// rig 'dzin rnams la dam bcas pa// nag bo chen po khyod la sbron// dam nyams dgra bo 'khor bcas rnams// tshar gcod las la khyod bskul lo// nag po chen po las la bh+yo// las mgon nag po las la bh+yo// lha mo nag mo las la bh+yo// ma mo thams cad las la bh+yo// lha srin sde brgyad las la bh+yo// zhes bskul te 'phang*/ 'brub khung steng gi 'khor lo de drag po'i gnas sam lam rgya gram gyi 'og tu las kyi gshin rje la gtad pa ri rab kyis mnan par bsam ste bya'o// gal te bzlog pa'i rtags byung na/ mgon po'i g.yas su mi nag rta zhon snying dang mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du lha mo nag mo drel zhon khram shing dang nad rkyal 'dzin pa gnyis bkod/ sngags gtso bo'i sham bur/ mahā kā la trag shad mahā kā la sid+dhi ya ma du dza dang*/ mahā kā li trag rak+ṣa raka mo thun bh+yo/ dza dza dza btags la bzla/ rbad dus/ mahā kā li rag mo sha sogs bsnan/ bsad las kyi mthar btags/ gtor ma chen po gcig gtso 'khor tu bskyed/ de la rak+ta sbran pa'i lid+ga gtor chung brgya rtsa/ oṃ he hi kro dha sogs kyis 'bul/ mthar zor du 'phang*/ sbyin sreg ma thub na tsher ma'i shing la hoṃ sbar/

de mgon po 'khor bcas kyi bstab pa'i dus lta bur bsam ste dgra bo 'khor bcas zhal du gsol bar bsam mo// thal ba phyed mnan phyed rlung la gtor/ rjes su gnang ba bya bar 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ bla ma mgon por gsal ba'i spyan sngar/ skyabs sems phog sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// 'phrin las thams cad sgrub mdzad pa// bdud 'dul nag po chen po yi// rjes gnang brtse bas rtsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ slob ma mgon por bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim dbang lha spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis bum pa spyi bor bkod de/ dpal ldan nag po chen po'i sku// ye shes bdud rtsi zhu ba'i chus// rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas// sku yi dngos grub thob gyur cig snying po'i mthar kā ya sid+dhi oṃ// de nas bdud rtsi mgrin par bkod/ gsung*/ wa ka sid+dhi āḥslob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags 'phreng 'thon// slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ snying po lan gsum bzla/ thugs phyag rgya chen por snang ba 'dis thugs/ tsit+ta sid+dhi/ de nas/ nus mthu thogs med bha ling+ta// yon tan thams cad 'grub gyur cig /karma sid+dhi pha la hoḥ de nas/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po khyod// sngags sgrub pho nya las byed du// mnga' gsol phur pa'i dbang bskur bas/ 'phrin las thams cad 'grub gyur cig / ces bstan/ rgyas par 'dod na gdab las gtor ma bzhin/ bsdus na nya'u la bla mas dgug gzhug byas las sngags kyis gnas lngar btab pas bsgral cing ro za'o// rten ni dpa' bo'i gri snying dbus su gtso bo/ g.yas su las mkhan/ g.yon du yum sngags bri/ rin po che/ 'bru/ snying po// bdud rtsi lnga sogs dang lhan du bzhag go /rten gtor bca' ba/ de bzhin 'phang nag mda' gang nal bu'i pags dang me long la sngags bris la/ mchod gtor spyi dang 'dra'o// pad+ma dkar pos rin chen bstan pa rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba ltar du byams pa chos gling du sbyar ba'o/// /
